rows: Washington Consensus author and date?
John Williamson, 1989; 10 policy recommendations for Latin America
Main Stiglitz critique of IMF?
Conditionality served creditor interests; austerity in recession is contractionary; sequencing wrong (capital liberalization before regulation)
China shock finding (Autor et al.)?
Chinese imports eliminated ~2.4M US manufacturing jobs 1999-2011; workers did NOT reabsorb as trade theory predicted
Why did MBS/CDO ratings fail?
Gaussian copula model assumed low default correlation; in housing bust, all mortgages correlated; diversification failed
What is a CDS?
Credit default swap: insurance-like contract on credit risk; AIG sold $400B+; not regulated as insurance; no reserve requirements
Why was Lehman's failure so catastrophic?
Counterparties froze; money market funds broke the buck; commercial paper market seized; interbank market froze simultaneously
QE mechanism?
Fed buys long-duration assets (Treasuries, MBS); injects reserves into banking system; lowers long-term yields; wealth effect
Triffin dilemma in SDR terms?
SDRs could theoretically replace dollar as reserve asset without requiring any country to run deficits; but were never made large enough
What reversed the Washington Consensus?
CHIPS Act ($52B, 2022) and Inflation Reduction Act ($369B, 2022) = explicit industrial policy; US acknowledged market failure in strategic industries
Why did 2022 inflation not become 1970s stagflation?
Fed acted faster; unions much weaker (10% vs 30%); inflationary expectations better anchored; wage-price spiral limited
